definitions.explanation: A period of reduced economic activity, declining business, or financial hardship.
Used figuratively to describe a gloomy atmosphere, a lack of energy, or a depressing state of affairs.

examples.japanese: {不景気|ふけいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
{不景気|ふけいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{失業|しつぎょう}→失業：03179_shitsugyou⟧⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The unemployment rate rose due to the recession.

examples.japanese: {不景気|ふけいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中小|ちゅうしょう}{企業|きぎょう}→中小企業：24117_chuushoukigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{倒産|とうさん}した→倒産する：26990_tousansuru⟧。
examples.english: Many small and medium-sized businesses went bankrupt due to the effects of the recession.

examples.japanese: {不景気|ふけいき}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He has a gloomy look on his face.

examples.japanese: {不景気|ふけいき}な⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧だ。
{不景気|ふけいき}な⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧「⟦ただいま→ただいま：01062_tadaima⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: He said 'I'm home' in a cheerless voice.

notes:
USAGE:
Functions as both a noun (describing economic conditions) and a na-adjective (modifying nouns). When used as a noun, it refers to an economic slump. As a na-adjective, it can describe gloomy expressions, atmospheres, or talk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不景気|ふけいき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (recession continues)
- {不景気|ふけいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ (effects of the recession)
- {不景気|ふけいき}な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (gloomy face)
- {不景気|ふけいき}⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ (winds of recession)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧: economic conditions; boom — the antonym; often implies good economic times
- ⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧: recession — a more formal and technical term for economic downturn
